basicInfo.description: Extremely immunodeficient mouse strain (Rag1 and Il2rg double null) used as a xenograft recipient; carries no disease phenotype of its own but is the standard host strain for engrafting human NF1-associated tumor cells (e.g. MPNST xenografts).
